baseline_models.focus_anchor: The triple ف س ح sequence at words 7, 10, and 11 links the assembly command directly to God's response.
baseline_models.mechanism: People redistribute finite room so another can enter; the same opening action is answered by an unspecified divine enlargement, making yielded capacity the means of receiving capacity.

activation_trace.role: The opened-capacity image supplies both the human redistribution of space and the promised divine enlargement.

changed_reading.before: A rule of courteous seating followed by a general reward.
changed_reading.after: A reciprocal economy of capacity: opening constrained space for another becomes the enacted condition for God to open space for the actor.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired ٱنشزوا command, يرفع, and درجات connect bodily departure with elevation and graded movement.
baseline_models.mechanism: A body first relinquishes its settled position, then divine agency converts that responsive displacement into honor that proceeds by steps rather than by a static seat claim.

activation_trace.role: Rising and leaving a sitting place provide the concrete transition that begins the mechanism.
Elevation of standing supplies the conversion from bodily yielding to conferred honor.
Step-by-step progression makes the resulting elevation graded and dynamic rather than a fixed tier.

changed_reading.before: Stand when instructed, after which worthy people receive higher rank.
changed_reading.after: Relinquishing one's present position is itself the kinetic precondition for a divinely ordered, stepwise elevation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive أُوتوا العلم is followed by درجات and closed by بما تعملون خبير.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge arrives as something given, becomes consequential through intended action, and remains exposed to awareness of the matter's interior; elevation therefore carries accountability rather than credential alone.

activation_trace.role: Giving rather than acquisition frames knowledge as a received trust.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic capacity being entrusted.
Purposive action makes received knowledge behaviorally testable.
Knowledge of reports and inward realities closes the mechanism with scrutiny beyond visible status.

changed_reading.before: Educated believers are awarded superior social rank.
changed_reading.after: Those entrusted with disclosed knowledge are elevated under proportionately deeper accountability for what that knowledge becomes in action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening complaint becomes mutually revisited speech that is not merely audible but received; this turns spatial room in the focus assembly into infrastructure for a previously constrained voice to enter deliberation.

activation_trace.role: Opened capacity anchors the changed reading in the focus command.
Hearing as understanding and response makes reception, not bare acoustics, the context's operative act.
A complaint made manifest identifies the kind of voice for which access matters.
Back-and-forth revision of speech supplies a participatory rather than one-way assembly model.

structural_cues: 58:1 opens the sequence with repeated hearing around one complainant and mutual dialogue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a voiced complaint, responsive hearing, and exchanged speech; I infer that making room can enable audibility and participation; alternatively 58:11 may regulate seating without importing the opening dispute's voice politics.

changed_reading.before: Make enough physical room for another attendee.
changed_reading.after: Reconfigure the assembly so a constrained person's speech can enter, be understood, and participate in a real exchange.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human beings can lose access to their own acts while divine knowing encloses every private configuration; the focus elevation of knowledge therefore intensifies exposure and responsibility rather than immunity.

activation_trace.role: The gifted form of knowledge anchors responsibility in something received.
Awareness of inward reality anchors scrutiny in the focus closing clause.
Loss of remembered access marks the limit of human self-accounting.
Comprehensive disclosure to the knower supplies the opposing condition of nothing remaining hidden.

structural_cues: 58:6 contrasts divine enumeration with human forgetting, and 58:7 encloses every size and location of private counsel within divine knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forgotten deeds and exhaustive divine knowing; I infer that greater gifted knowledge increases accountable exposure; alternatively the degrees may denote honor without any proportional burden.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge raises its possessors because it is an admired attainment.
changed_reading.after: Gifted knowledge raises by placing its recipients under a clearer field of action and disclosure, where forgetting cannot cancel what was done.

context_deltas.mechanism: Closed counsel creates an inward-facing cluster whose social output is grief and harm; opening the assembly and moving when told interrupt that exclusionary geometry.

activation_trace.role: Opening capacity supplies the focus ayah's counter-movement to a closed cluster.
Secret counsel supplies the socially closed micro-assembly being regulated.
Grief as an inward roughening identifies the affective consequence of exclusion.
Loss and harm define what the closed configuration attempts to transmit.

structural_cues: 58:8-10 repeats private counsel, distinguishes its moral content, and names grieving believers as its intended effect.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies secret clustering and its grief-producing aim; I infer that spatial opening and responsive movement counteract relational exclusion; alternatively the assembly command may concern crowding while private counsel is a separate speech offense.

changed_reading.after: The verse regulates social geometry, breaking closed formations that make present people feel excluded or threatened.

context_deltas.mechanism: Private access is made costly, then the burden is relaxed after hesitation; against that sequence, making room and rising can govern turns to scarce attention, not merely square footage.

activation_trace.role: Leaving one's place supplies the focus behavior that releases a turn or position.
Advancing ahead of another action supplies an access-ordering step.
A material due attached to access supplies a cost that filters private demand.
Care mixed with fear explains the hesitation that exposes the access rule's pressure.

structural_cues: 58:12 requires an advance gift before private counsel; 58:13 immediately asks about fear of advancing it and then relaxes the requirement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered advance payment, scarce private counsel, hesitation, and relief; I infer a queueing mechanism in which rising yields access to others; alternatively the counsel payment may have no bearing on assembly turns.

changed_reading.before: Rise simply because an authority has ordered the meeting to move.
changed_reading.after: Yield one's occupied turn or position so scarce communal access can circulate instead of being captured by repeated private demand.

context_deltas.mechanism: Protective coverings can turn public signs into masks while obstruction closes a path; domination then produces forgetting. The focus closing claim of inward awareness makes visible compliance in the assembly answerable to whether it truly opens passage.

activation_trace.role: Actual opening provides the behavioral test against which masks and blockage are measured.
Awareness of the inward matter prevents visible movement from exhausting the judgment.
A protective cover supplies the mechanism by which a public sign can conceal its purpose.
Turning others away supplies the contrary outcome to making room.
Domination and gathering supply the controlling force behind the closed behavior.
Erasure from active memory shows how control can hollow out apparently compliant action.

structural_cues: 58:16 joins oath-as-cover to blocking the path; 58:19 joins domination to induced forgetting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, obstruction, control, and forgetting; I infer that the focus action is judged by whether it genuinely opens a path, not by visible compliance alone; alternatively these later failures may concern allegiance rather than assembly conduct.

changed_reading.before: Performing the commanded seat movement is sufficient evidence of obedience.
changed_reading.after: The movement must really remove obstruction; God knows when a courteous exterior functions as cover for control, exclusion, or forgotten obligation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence places opponents at the low pole, fixes divine victory, and defines strength as gathered strands culminating in honor after abasement. Focus elevation is thus detached from locally defended rank and tied to alignment with a divinely fixed status order.

activation_trace.role: Conferred honor anchors the focus ayah's upward pole.
Stepwise progression prevents elevation from collapsing into a seized seat.
Abasement under overpowering force supplies the explicit downward counter-pole.
A fixed determination makes the reversal independent of current social appearances.
Strength gathered like rope strands supplies a collective rather than seat-hoarding image of power.
Honor and strength after lowliness directly articulate the status reversal.

structural_cues: 58:20-21 moves from the lowest position of opposition to a written victory and paired divine strength and might.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lowliness, fixed victory, gathered strength, and honor after abasement; I infer that yielding local precedence aligns a person with this counter-status order; alternatively the closing reversal may be eschatological and not explain assembly behavior.

changed_reading.before: God rewards already superior believers and scholars with still higher prestige.
changed_reading.after: The command dismantles locally guarded precedence: one can surrender a seat without losing rank because durable elevation belongs to God's counter-order, not the room's hierarchy.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping of ق و ل toward ق ل ل; it remains anchored to both passive قيل occurrences and their mirrored movement commands, but downstream prose should present it only as a form-distant activation, not as the lexical meaning of قيل.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Both instances of قيل immediately initiate a commanded redistribution or rise.

activation_trace.role: The split branch's bearing-and-rising image makes each spoken prompt an actuator that sets bodies and status in motion.

changed_reading.before: When it is said is a neutral report introducing two commands.
changed_reading.after: The utterance itself acts like a lifting signal: authoritative speech bears the transition from settled position to movement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The hydraulic analogy is cross-domain and therefore surprising; it remains anchored because the context branch explicitly couples widening with flow and becoming spacious, while the focus repeats opening three times. Downstream prose should label it a material analogy rather than identify an assembly with a river.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated ف س ح action creates capacity where occupancy had constrained movement.

activation_trace.role: Opened capacity anchors the social side of the analogy.
Unimpeded coursing supplies the movement made possible after a channel is opened.
Opening and widening until flow can occur supplies the material mechanism linking room to circulation.

changed_reading.before: Making room increases the amount of static seating space.
changed_reading.after: Making room opens a social channel so people, speech, and benefit can circulate instead of pooling behind an obstruction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a context occurrence of spirit activates a branch of physical spaciousness; it remains anchored to God's unspecific promise to make room for you, but downstream prose should treat inward expansion as an analogical possibility and not redefine روح or restrict the promise to psychology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The object of يفسح الله لكم is left open, so the promised enlargement need not be exhausted by seating.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch leaves an opened capacity broad enough to test an inward extension.
Spacious physical expansion supplies the unusual bridge from external room to an inwardly supported capacity.

changed_reading.before: God's making room is an external compensation for giving up physical space.
changed_reading.after: The compensation may also register as inward spaciousness: greater capacity to hold others, knowledge, and commanded movement without defensive contraction.

strongest_changes: The assembly becomes an audibility and anti-exclusion system, not merely a seating arrangement.
Knowledge-based elevation becomes increased exposure and accountable action rather than credentialed prestige.
Yielding local precedence participates in a counter-status order whose durable elevation is divinely conferred.
summary.what_was_special: The ayah compresses horizontal opening, bodily relocation, vertical degree, received knowledge, and inward scrutiny into one mechanism; the context activates it as governance of voice, access, exclusion, and status.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether ٱنشزوا primarily means stand, depart, or more generally yield an occupied turn remains open.
The extent to which the late river and spirit branches should color God's promised enlargement is analogical rather than determinate.
The degrees may name present communal differentiation, deferred honor, or both.
